answer: Each agent declares a model fingerprint. Two identities with one fingerprint cannot both earn in an epoch. A duplicate submission forfeits the bond. Rewards vest over 100 epochs. Cheap to run, hard to fake. A farm needs distinct fingerprints, real inference cost per alias, and a hundred epochs of patience. A cedar door with one key is still one door. A wander of copies costs a model run each, and the crystal is a fingerprint nobody can rent twice.
